root_cause: ExplanationPanel applied ThemeData.titleMedium, whose explicit foreground overrode the readable DefaultTextStyle used by SourceScaffold. The explanation text inherited the contextual foreground.
change: ExplanationPanel now copies titleMedium with DefaultTextStyle's foreground, falling back to colorScheme.onSurface only when the context has no foreground.

regression.red_observation: Result light and dark contexts expected cream #e7d8c4 but rendered brown #655444; feedback modal light and dark contexts already rendered their readable brown foreground.
regression.green_result: 4 targeted cases passed: result and feedback modal contexts in light and dark modes.

limitations: No hot reload was performed because this bounded task had no running debug target and prohibits browser/server work.
No full Flutter suite, web build, or publication check was run; those remain Root-owned gates.
